title: #3 Translated News Releases - All Languages & News Release Pages

dashboard_elements.body_text:
Filter - Date: Input the date range you want to view results for. Results are currently available for the last completed 24 months.
Filter - Page Title: Only applicable to News Release Pages - Page Views report tile. Input the page title for the page or pages you want to see page views for. A reminder to put the various potential spellings of the title if necessary.
Filter - Page URL: Input the URL of the page or pages you want to see download clicks for. A reminder to input the various potential URL spellings.
Filter - Downloaded File: Only applicable to Translated News Releases – All Languages report tile. Input the PDF URL or URLs if you want to view results for a specific PDF. A reminder to input the various potential URL spellings. For example, include uppercase and lowercase versions if applicable, etc.
View or Download More Rows/Columns of Data: The current live view limit is 20 rows & 50 columns. To view or download more rows/columns of data, use the "Advanced data options" of the "Download Data" option. Go to the online guide for instructions.

query.dynamic_fields:
[{"category":"table_calculation","label":"% of Downloads","value_format":null,"value_format_name":"percent_1","calculation_type":"percent_of_column_sum","table_calculation":"of_downloads","args":["clicks.download_click_count"],"_kind_hint":"measure","_type_hint":"number","expression":"(${clicks.download_click_count} / sum(${clicks.download_click_count}))"},{"category":"dimension","expression":"if(
  (
    position(lower(${clicks.target_display_url}), "https://govbcnews.azureedge.net/translations/releases") = 1
    OR position(lower(${clicks.target_display_url}), "https://bcgovnews-etg7c8etapa6btfr.z03.azurefd.net/translations/releases") = 1
  )
  AND contains(lower(${clicks.target_display_url}), ".pdf")
  AND (
    contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Arabic")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Chinese(simplified)")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Chinese(Simplified)")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Chinese(traditional)")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Chinese(Traditional)")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Dutch")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Farsi")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Finnish")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_French")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Gujarati")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Hebrew")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Hindi")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Indonesian")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Japanese")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Korean")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Portuguese")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Punjabi")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Russian")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Somali")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Spanish")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Swahili")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Tagalog")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Ukrainian")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Urdu")
    OR contains(${clicks.target_display_url}, "_Vietnamese")
  )
  AND NOT (
    contains(lower(${clicks.target_display_url}), "_chinese%28simplified%29")
    OR contains(lower(${clicks.target_display_url}), "_chinese%28traditional%29")
  ),
  "Yes","No"
)
","label":"is_translated_release","value_format":null,"value_format_name":null,"dimension":"is_translated_release","_kind_hint":"dimension","_type_hint":"string"}]
